# Apply Fixes

## Change Summary

Added shrimp-routing invariant enforcement in `crates/tank_core/src/invariants.rs` for `animal.reserve_g`, the shrimp assimilation/respiration/excretion/growth fractions, and `shrimp_o2_per_mg_c_respired`; made `Engine::step_hours` reject invalid state before the first simulated hour; aligned `crates/tank_core/src/systems/shrimp.rs`, `docs/ROUTING.md`, and `docs/scientific_inventory.md` with the phase-1 TAN+DOC dissolved-excretion contract; and added regression tests in `crates/tank_core/tests/save_load.rs` and `crates/tank_core/tests/validation.rs` for malformed v4 saves and invalid shrimp process params.

## Steps

1. [Completed] Enforced shrimp routing parameter bounds/sum rules plus non-negative `animal.reserve_g` in invariant checks.
2. [Completed] Validated engine state before hourly simulation begins so malformed saves or direct `TankState` construction fail before any shrimp routing runs.
3. [Completed] Updated routing/scientific docs and added regression tests for malformed v4 saves plus invalid shrimp runtime parameters.

## Validation Evidence

- `cargo test -p tank_core --test save_load --test validation --test shrimp_feeding_pathway` passed.
- `cargo test -p tank_core` was run; all exercised suites passed except `crates/tank_core/tests/shrimp_population.rs::hatch_produces_juveniles`, which still fails outside the edited paths.
- `cargo fmt --all` was run after the code/test edits.

## Outstanding Risks

- `cargo test -p tank_core` still reports an unrelated failure in `crates/tank_core/tests/shrimp_population.rs::hatch_produces_juveniles`, so the full suite is not green from this workspace state.
- The worktree already contains unrelated changes in `crates/tank_core/tests/overfeeding_effects.rs` and an untracked `.ralph-burning/` directory, which I left untouched.
